findings.text: Acceptance 2/5: selecting Wiki from Activity opens Home. Reproduced using the task's bootApp harness: state.view='notifications'; views.render(); await go('#/wiki') produced {view:'chat',place:'home',wikiTree:false}. setSidebarPlace records a null navigation key before goPlace switches to chat, so followPlace overrides the explicit Wiki choice. Establish the baseline after switching views.

Acceptance 4: reopening the current wiki page through a non-route entry leaves its tree hidden. Reproduced in the task's Node harness: await openWikiPage('nowosci'); sidebar.setSidebarPlace('home'); await openWikiPage('nowosci') produced {view:'wiki',place:'home',wikiTree:false}. The unchanged navigation key suppresses this explicit navigation. Select Wiki on page-opening actions while allowing ordinary redraws to preserve the chosen place.

Acceptance 3/5: delayed route completion overrides a newer place selection. Reproduced with the task's Node harness: hold GET /api/wiki/slow, navigate to #/wiki/slow, then #/dms, and release the GET. Output changed from {hash:'#/dms',place:'dms'} to {hash:'#/dms',place:'wiki'}. settleRoutePlace runs unconditionally after the await. Apply the place when navigation starts, or guard completion against newer navigation, rail selections and session changes.
